messages:
elena: Pushed runtime v3.2.0 to staging ~90m ago. Canary shows kernel-selector chose a new quant exec path for llama3q-quant which caused intermittent longseq failures. Anyone seeing this in infra graphs?

deploybot: canary summary: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/1747090001 — overall green except longseq-stress (failure rate ~9%).
mike: confirmed in p3 traces: token p99 up ~25% for quant-v4b on long sequences. Memory allocation pattern changed around KV cache warmup.
ryan: sounds like kernel selection drift. Options: (1) soft-pin runtime to 3.1 for affected model cohort, (2) full rollback of 3.2, (3) ship hotfix to selector. My vote is soft-pin+hotfix. Lower blast radius.
elena: agree with soft-pin for staging+canary cohorts. We'll block a prod unpin until we validate hotfix on canary. Also want clear rollback thresholds.
jin: I'll liaise with oncall and block unpin in change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. If any of the thresholds are met, we'll auto-escalate.
mike: opened hotfix branch and PR w/trace diffs: https://git.redwood/runtime/compare/ramps-1749 — added smoke tests to detect regressed kernel path.
deploybot: applied pin at 1747092000 to cohort "staging-llama3q-quant" by @elena. Pin metadata: ```pinlist:
- runtime: "3.1.0"
  models:
    - "llama3q-quant*"
  reason: "kernel-selector drift -> longseq failures"
  owner: "eng-runtime"
  applied_at: "1747092000"
```
ryan: for release notes we should include a compatibility notice: "Customers using long-sequence workloads on quantized llama3 variants may observe token-latency changes with runtime 3.2. Pin to 3.1 for stability or contact support for assistance."
elena: adding rollback criteria to the PR: error-rate >=5% OR median token latency increase >=20% over baseline => auto-rollback trigger. Jin will monitor.
jin: standing by during window. Will post alerts in #incidents if thresholds crossed. :eyes: :rotating_light:
mike: we'll iterate on kernel-selector heuristics in the hotfix; if it lands clean on canary we'll plan an opt-in gradual rollout for prod.
elena: TL;DR: soft-pin applied to staging cohort, hotfix PR open, prod unpin blocked until canary green. I'll draft the short ops note and a blurb for the release-notes team. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
